Overview

Bordeaux is a city in Nouvelle-Aquitaine with a population of 260,000. The world capital of wine, with elegant 18th-century architecture, a vibrant riverfront, and renowned vineyards. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
